about_photo_alt: Professional profile photo of Damian Argalski
about_hero_headline: Hi, I'm Damian Argalski, and I create digital experiences.
about_intro_paragraph1: I am an ambitious Full-Stack Developer (with a particular passion for Frontend) with a clear goal: to find my first job where I can utilize my skills to build efficient and **visually precise** web applications. My main technologies are **Vue/Tailwind CSS** and **Node.js/MongoDB**.
about_intro_paragraph2: My work is guided by the **pixel-perfect** principle – a 1px misalignment or a minimal difference in shade is a bug to me. If I do something, I do it seriously. Thanks to this attention to detail, I deliver interfaces that not only work but also guarantee an exceptional User Experience.
about_philosophy_text: I believe that every line of code should add value and be easy to maintain. I focus on user experience, performance, and scalability. I believe in continuous learning and adapting to changing technologies, as well as open team communication as the key to any project's success. **My unique asset is an obsession with visual and technical quality.**
about_journey_milestone1_desc: I remember the frustration when learning my first framework (React) – I understood nothing, but curiosity and the desire to build pushed me forward. This moment defined my determination to master the technology.
about_journey_milestone2_desc: Switching to Vue.js and Tailwind CSS allowed me to combine attention to design with efficiency. This is my current, preferred stack, in which I build the fastest and cleanest.
about_journey_milestone3_desc: I am currently focused on building solid projects (like SkillShare) to prove my worth as a Junior Full/Front-end Developer ready to bring real value to a professional team.
about_hobbies_title: What Do I Do When I'm Not Coding?
about_hobbies_text: Outside the world of code, I am passionate about **motorcycles, cars, and gym training**. These passions, though different, share the need for attention to detail, precision, and continuous improvement, which translates into my approach to programming: striving for optimal performance and reliability.
about_final_cta_text: If you are looking for an ambitious, meticulous, and determined person who delivers 'pixel perfect' quality code, I'd be happy to discuss potential collaboration.
